author: cellish
body:
So basically I've made a new map called Darkwoods. This is a CTW map that I first thought of making for the tournament but Idk. The map might be very stalemate so skybridging is a good advantage.

Images: http://imgur.com/a/Hl0Yb
Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?l4aqqm41qei51qs
XML: Soon
Video: https://youtu.be/_AUyTXgWqk8 (subscribe :P)
Teams: Blue & Green
Blue Wools (to defend): Purple & Yellow
Green Wools (to defend): Red & Pink

If you want to take a closer look at the map you can do /mvtp Sam8 on alex's build server.
Please give me opinions of what you think of the map and tell me what I should Improve etc.

Thanks!

-Sam

- Make woolrooms further away from the redstone line: easier to defend and more space:


- Changed the biome to swampland for better looks:


- Added an elevated middle island to make skybridging/groundpushing easier as well as less stale gameplay:

replies.author: ChertanProject
replies.body:
I'm beyonduh btw.
from what I see, it's a good map and adding the islands between the two sides was a good choice. but since u said that this was a tournament map, I personally believe that u should get rid of the walls in front of the wool room as this map already has two sides to defend and then having to also get rid of the cobwebs and that wall will be a trek defending, especially when this map is the sort of map u will see a skybridge on, which makes defending really difficult and also barely any competitive ctw maps in my memory ever had a bedrock and cobwebs wall except for those really old ones built like 4 years ago. also another one is u should put the defence supply chest at spawn since it is extremely easy for the offenders to abuse the defenders when they r in the wool by breaking the chest and taking all of the supplies. PS: making there Redstone blocks instead of Redstone dust in the chest will make defenders really happy and they will give better feedback on the map;)
